definitions.explanation: An injury to the skin caused by heat, fire, hot liquids, or steam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{火傷|やけど}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got burned by hot water.

examples.japanese: {火傷|やけど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please run cold water over the burn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{火傷|やけど}⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}れば→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: If it's a minor burn, applying medicine should be fine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はねて→跳ねる：04378_haneru⟧、⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火傷|やけど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Oil splattered while I was cooking and I got a burn on my hand.

examples.japanese: {火傷|やけど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{消|き}えなくて→消える：02520_kieru⟧、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{長袖|ながそで}→長袖：15517_nagasode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The burn scar won't go away, so I wear long sleeves even in summer.

notes:
USAGE: {火傷|やけど} can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a suru-verb ({火傷|やけど}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to get burned).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {火傷|やけど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to get a burn)
- {火傷|やけど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧ (to sustain a burn - formal)
- {火傷|やけど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧ (the burn heals)
- {火傷|やけど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (burn scar)

SEVERITY LEVELS:
- ⟦{軽度|けいど}→軽度：28013_keido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火傷|やけど} (minor burn)
- ⟦{重度|じゅうど}→重度：28683_juudo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火傷|やけど} (severe burn)

WARNING: For serious burns, seek medical attention. The expression {火傷|やけど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功名|こうみょう}→功名：noentry⟧ (lit. success from getting burned) means achieving something through a mistake or failure.
